source_text: 你如果到北京旅游，必须做两件事：一件是登长城，另一件是吃北京烤鸭。闻名 遐迩的北京烤鸭曾仅限于宫廷，而现在北京数百家餐厅均有供应。 北京烤鸭源于600 年前的明代。来自全国各地的厨师被挑选出来到京城为皇帝做 饭。人们认为在皇宫做饭是一种莫大的荣誉，只有厨艺出众者才能获得这份工作。 事实上，正是这些宫廷厨师使北京烤鸭的烹饪艺术日臻完善。
reference_translation: If you travel to Beijing, you must do two things: one is to climb the Great Wall, and the other is to eat Beijing Roast Duck. The world-famous Beijing Roast Duck used to be only available in the imperial court, but now it is served in hundreds of restaurants in Beijing. Beijing Roast Duck dates back to the Ming Dynasty 600 years ago. Chefs from all over the country were selected to cook for the emperor in the capital. People regarded cooking in the royal palace as a great honor, and only those with excellent cooking skills could get this job. In fact, it was these imperial chefs who gradually perfected the cooking art of Beijing Roast Duck.
